text_block_list.text: A few weeks before the Victoria Mile――

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Messiah at the Shuka Sho...
No matter how many times I watch it, she's truly magnificent."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Craft's a girl of her word, too.
Paving her own path in the mile division—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: And so, what about me...?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah! It's not at all the track record I had pictured.
Just a string of lackluster defeats!
—Well, for now, that is!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "Yes, for now! That's why we have to do something about it."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—But how?
Right now, what I lack the most is...?
(Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Nnh...
—Come in!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Pardon me...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! For our class assignment,
we're supposed to ask an upperclassman
about the Twinkle Series...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
We'd like you to fill out a questionnaire,
and, um, we were really hoping Heart-san could do it...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what a nice assignment.
Okay! Leave it to me, I'll write it down!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you very much...!
Then, um... I'll put it over there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for troubling you when you are busy.
I look forward to working with you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"...A questionnaire, huh...
Are these all original questions? Huh—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
...... "Heart-san's unyielding spirit and her constant demeanor
of striving to be a queen at all times."

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"I am deeply impressed by her strong spirit,
always fearlessly facing challenges head-on—"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: "What should I do to become an Umamusume like you?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Fufu! Ahahaha! What is this...!
What an incredible fan letter!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I see. So that's how it is.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: So that's how I look to you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: ...Heh, no...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No, silly me!
(No, that's silly of you, Heart!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I've never been like that to begin with.
To possess a bold, powerful, and unyielding spirit—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: She's an exceptionally daring queen!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Come on—I can't be slacking off!
Next time, I've gotta show everyone my power for sure!
And the next morning—

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"How can you become like me?
Okay! I'll show you in our next race.
I'll show you the queen's brilliance!"
And as time went on—

The ultimate showdown of the Tiara:
it's Victoria Mile race day!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah--!!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: ...! How incredible—!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Haa, haa, haa, haa...!
Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hi! Cesario...!
You're pretty fast, aren't you? Phew...!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: No... Mr. Heart, you're the one who's looking quiteâ

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Of course!
Today is the Victoria Mile, after all!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I'm putting everything on that race.
No matter what it takes, I'm going to etch my name into history.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
So yes!
You should prepare yourself too, understood?

"Ever since that day,
we've continued our training while searching
for the meaning of Air Messiah's 'radiance.'"

Looking at her growth curve, her abilities are in top shape.
However, in the end, we couldn't find the answer regarding her "radiance"...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"...To tell the truth, there's something
bothering me a bit about Heart-san."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
"This morning, I caught sight of her
training."

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
She dashed across the freshly dawn-lit grounds,
recklessly, running with singular, wholehearted focus—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
It was truly... just like the sheer drive Messiah-san showed
during the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: In today's race, Craft is the one the public expects the most from, and—

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Considering her recent record,
Messiah is the one we need to keep our eyes on.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However... seeing how she was,
I want to make sure I keep a close eye on Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
—It might also serve as a way
to gain a hint toward that “radiance.”

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text: "In any case, Trainer, please keep a close eye on her."

To seize what must be seized.
The Victoria Mile begins—!
